elevenlabsPrompt:
[exasperated] A stranger on the train just tried to send you a photo?

[confident] Here's the fix. Set Quick Share to Contacts.

[friendly] Open Settings, then Connected devices. Tap Connection preferences, then Quick Share. Set who can share with you to Contacts.

[delighted] Now only people you know can even ask.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
